## 🎯 Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe clearly.
*Example: As a student, I'm always frustrated when I want to tag notes by exam date...*

## ✨ Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups or Screenshots
If applicable, sketch or provide mockups/screenshots of how this should look.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, references, or academic use cases here.
